title: Phase 1/2 Trial of Immunotherapy Combination in BRAF V600E Mutant Metastatic Colorectal Cancer

inclusion_criteria.description: Histologically confirmed metastatic colorectal cancer with BRAF V600E mutation.
Adequate hepatic function: AST/ALT <= 2.5x ULN (or <= 5.0x ULN in presence of liver metastases).

exclusion_criteria.description: Prior treatment with BRAF inhibitors (e.g. Encorafenib, Dabrafenib).
